title: Surreal Cosmic Nightmare
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a green frog with spiral eyes sitting on a melting orange pumpkin that drips into reflective water. A giant purple-haired woman with a screaming face and multiple arms emerges from a cratered moon-like sphere with teeth and eyes, while a black horned silhouette with glowing red eyes holds crackling energy in the foreground. A stormy city skyline, lightning, a spiral sun, and falling meteors fill the chaotic night sky.
